attchmntText: Godawari Power And Ispat limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Godawari Power & Ispat Limited filed an investor presentation for Q2 and H1 FY27. Consolidated revenue grew 29% year-on-year to Rs. 3,382 crore in H1FY27. EBITDA declined 9% to Rs. 530 crore, with margins at 16%. Profit after tax fell 19% to Rs. 307 crore, with PAT margins at 9%. The company cited higher iron ore and coal costs as key profitability pressures. The 5.4 MnT beneficiation plant is scheduled for commissioning in Q3FY27. A 20 GWh Battery Energy Storage System project is slated for Q1FY28. Credit facilities aggregating Rs. 2,795 crore were sanctioned for the BESS project. The company aims for margin recovery from Q4FY27.

attchmntText: Godawari Power And Ispat limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Godawari Power & Ispat Limited confirms no deviation or variation in the use of proceeds from its preferential issue of Fully Convertible Warrants. The funds were raised on 14-11-2025, totaling Rs. 175.23 crore. The statement of nil deviation for the quarter ended 30-09-2026 has been reviewed by the Audit Committee. The monitoring agency is CARE Ratings Limited. Funds were allocated to Project Funding, Investment in BESS Project, and General Corporate Purposes. For the quarter, Rs. 0.22 crore was utilized for Project Funding, and Rs. 175 crore was utilized for the Investment in BESS Project. The total unutilized amount as of 30-09-2026 is Rs. 0.008 crore. No comments were recorded by the Audit Committee or auditors. The disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 32 of the SEBI LODR Regulations.

attchmntText: Godawari Power And Ispat limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 5,00,00,000 Preference shares aggregating Rs. 50.00 Cr by Godawari New Energy Private Limited, A wholly owned Subsidiary of Godawari Power and Ispat Limited on 12.11.2026
voiceSummary: Godawari Power and Ispat Limited received intimation on 13th November 2026 regarding the allotment of 5,00,00,000 Non-Cumulative Participating Optionally Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares of Rs.10/- each to its wholly owned subsidiary, Godawari New Energy Private Limited. The allotment occurred on 12th November 2026. The total investment value is Rs.50.00 Crores. These shares represent Series 2 preference shares issued on a right basis. The funds will be utilized for capital expenditure and working capital requirements to set up a Battery Energy Storage System plant. Godawari New Energy Private Limited was incorporated on 25th June 2025 and has not yet started business. The transaction is classified as a related party transaction.

attchmntText: Please find attached herewith the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended 30.09.2026.
voiceSummary: Godawari Power and Ispat Limited submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The report was issued by CARE Ratings Limited on November 13, 2026. It concerns the utilization of proceeds from a Preferential Issue aggregating Rs. 500.00 crore. The issue involved fully convertible equity share warrants allotted between September 18, 2025, and November 7, 2025. The monitoring agency noted no deviation from the objects of the issue. No adverse observations were recorded. There was no utilization of funds during the quarter. The company received Rs. 175.23 crore out of the total Rs. 500.00 crore. Rs. 175.22 crore remains unutilized. Rs. 0.008 crore is invested in Axis Bank on demand. The equity warrants were allotted at Rs. 245 per share. The share price was Rs. 222.50 per share as of September 30, 2026. The price declined to Rs. 193.75 per share as of October 30, 2026. The monitoring agency warned that sustained trading below the exercise price may reduce the incentive for warrant holders to exercise. This could impact the realization of the remaining 75% of expected proceeds.

attchmntText: Submission of Financial Results for the period ended 30.09.2026.
voiceSummary: Godawari Power and Ispat Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 on 13th November 2026. The board approved a capital expenditure of Rs.135 Crores for a 3 GWh BESS project in Sambhajinagar, expected to commission by March 2028. An additional investment of Rs.110 Crores in subsidiary Godawari New Energy Private Limited was approved, bringing total investment to Rs.810 Crores. The Cold Rolling Mill project location changed to Sambhajinagar with revised costs of Rs.1100 Crores. A Rs.100 Crores container manufacturing line and Rs.100 Crores for EV dumpers were also approved. Godawari New Energy Private Limited will raise Rs.2795 Crores in debt, backed by a corporate guarantee from the company. A Rs.20 Crores investment in Godawari Energy Solutions Private Limited and a Rs.26 Crores strategic investment for a 26% stake in Solarcraft Power India 32 Private Limited were approved. The board adopted a new corporate logo and revised policies. The alteration to the GPIL Employee Stock Option Plan 2023 is subject to shareholder approval.

attchmntText: Godawari Power And Ispat limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Godawari power and ispat Limited, Unveils New Brand Identity, Heralds a New Chapter of Growth".
voiceSummary: Godawari Power and Ispat Limited filed a press release on 13th November 2026 regarding the unveiling of its new corporate logo. The new brand identity was revealed during the second quarter of the fiscal year 2026–27 board meeting. The initiative aims to unify the Group's diverse businesses under the ONE Godawari master brand. The new logo features a red motif symbolizing progress. The brand promise is Powering New Horizons. The transformation seeks to strengthen brand equity and stakeholder confidence. The new identity will be implemented progressively across business verticals. The company operates in mining, steel, ferro alloys, and power. It also has interests in energy storage, healthcare, and real estate. The press release was submitted to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited pursuant to SEBI regulations.
